name: Sentora x Spark RLUSD
oneLiner: sxsRLUSD is Sentora and Spark's RLUSD vault on Morpho; shares hold idle RLUSD and WBTC-backed loans, with withdrawals subject to liquidity.
collateral: RLUSD held idle in an immutable Morpho Vault V2 and supplied by a MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 to a WBTC-collateralized lending market. Allocations can change under curator controls.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares convert to RLUSD at the live assets-per-share rate. Interest increases and recognized losses reduce share value; withdrawals use idle assets and configured adapter liquidity rather than a fixed dollar promise.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The current exact holder instrument ethereum:0xfc8c624b6080a0a780583799f2a862de936f6e22 is an immutable ERC-4626 operational claim on idle RLUSD plus Morpho lender positions, not a direct fiat reserve claim. Deposit/mint requires underlying assets and accrual can issue fee shares. The only funded market lent RLUSD against WBTC at 86% LLTV. The adapter position had zero borrowing and zero posted collateral.
